[Intro]
[Am]

[Chorus]
[Am]When I watch the
[F]world burn
[G]All I think a-
[C]bout is [C/B]you
[Am]When I watch the
[F]world burn
[G]All I think a-
[C]bout is [C/B]you

[Verse 1]
[Am]There must be something in the
[F]KoolAid Cruising through the
[G]doom days God knows what is
[Am]real and what is fake
Last couple years have been a
[F]mad trip How'd y'all look so
[G]perfect? You must have some
[Am]portraits in the attic

[Verse 2]
[Am]We'll stay offline so no one
[F]gets hurt Hiding from the
[G]real world Just don't read the
[Am]comments ever, ever
We fucked this house up like the
[F]planet We were running
[G]riot Crazy that some
[Am]people still deny it

[Verse 3]
[Am]Think I'm addicted to my
[F]phone My scrolling horror
[G]show I'm livestreaming the
[Am]final days of Rome
One tab along, it's porno-
[F]graphic Everybody's
[G]at it No surprise we're
[Am]so easily bored

[Verse 4]
[Am]Let's pick the truth that we be-
[F]lieve in Like a bad re-
[G]ligion Tell me all your
[Am]original sins
So many questionable
[F]choices We love the sound that our
[G]voice makes Man, this echo
[Am]chamber's getting loud

[Bridge]
[Am]We're gonna choose the blue pill
[F]We're gonna close the curtains
[G]We're gonna rabbit hole down,
[C]third act [C/B]love now
[Am]She's gonna flip some tables
[F]I'm gonna move this tale on
[G]We're gonna rabbit hole down,
[C]third act [C/B]love now
[Am]We'll be the proud remainers
[F]Here 'til the morning breaks us
[G]We run away from real life
[C]thoughts [C/B]tonight
[Am]We're gonna Peter Pan out
[F]Fade to the closeup, arms 'round
[G]We're gonna stay naive to-
[C]night, night, [C/B]night

[Chorus]
[Am]When I watch the
[F]world burn
[G]All I think a-
[C]bout is [C/B]you
[Am]When I watch the
[F]world burn
[G]All I think a-
[C]bout is [C/B]you
[Am]You
[F]
[G]All I think a-
[Cmaj7/E]bout is you
[C]So I put my
[F]phone down
[G]Fall into the
[C]night with you
title: Doom Days
tuning: E A D G B E
